manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
description:
Cast Vishgraz either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens and three 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Squirrels and Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.
